title: Recording 1
text: This is recording one of three. This is ordinary test speech, not a hadith or a religious reading. We are checking whether a short listening session can continue when your iPhone is locked. Start this test with your phone connected to the internet. Once you hear this introduction, lock your screen and leave the phone alone. You do not need to keep this page visible. At the end of this recording, a second recording should begin automatically. Listen for the spoken number at the beginning of each recording. If the sound stops, note which recording you last heard. This voice is only for testing playback, and is not the proposed final narrator. You are now approaching the end of recording one. Recording two should follow.

title: Recording 2
text: This is recording two of three. If your phone is still locked and you heard this recording begin without touching the screen, the first transition worked. This is still ordinary test speech, with no religious source material. Keep listening for a little longer. During a separate run, you can try pausing from the lock screen, waiting a few seconds, and then resuming. You can also try your headphones. Please record what you actually hear, even if a control appears to work on the screen. A smooth listening experience means the words remain audible, your place is preserved, and the next recording starts. This test will finish after the third recording. You are now approaching the end of recording two. Recording three should follow.

title: Recording 3
text: This is recording three of three. If you have heard all three recordings with your phone locked, both transitions worked in this run. That is useful evidence, but we will also check interruptions and offline playback separately. When you return to the page, record the result in the checklist. The page keeps your observations on this device. Nothing is sent automatically. You can copy a short report to share in our conversation. For the offline check, first download the test audio using the button on the page, then switch on airplane mode and start again. Thank you for checking this on your own phone. The final app will use reviewed recordings matched to verified text. This completes the listening test. Playback will now stop.
